description: This file contains a PHP class implementing a parser for event condition expressions, generated by ANTLR, including methods for parsing comparisons, inclusion clauses, and value extraction, with references to external ANTLR runtime components.

classes.name: VTEventConditionParserParser
classes.description: A PHP class generated by ANTLR for parsing event condition expressions in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: statement
methods.description: Parses a statement which can be a comparison or an inclusion clause.

methods.name: comparision
methods.description: Parses a comparison expression of the form SYMBOL '==' value.

methods.name: inclause
methods.description: Parses an inclusion clause of the form SYMBOL IN listelement.

methods.name: listelement
methods.description: Parses a list of values enclosed in brackets.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Extracts a string value, stripping quotes.
